agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD responded that transportation issues are discussed in the final statement and that problems of poorly planned storage yards and parking areas can be controlled through local zoning and other controls.
text:
Response: The general problem of transportation has been discussed in the final statement. Problems of poorly planned storage

yards and parking areas can be controlled under local zoning and other controls.
